collection.title: Mercedes-Benz Vito 2010 to 2014 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following blades for the Mercedes-Benz Vito Van 2010 to 2014 (639) will fit, this model requires a 28" wiper blade on the drivers side with a 26" for the passengers side. This model uses the Pinch Tab arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a rear screen wiper for this Vito which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
